messages.subject: Re: New Problems on running rstan and rstudio

On Friday, July 29, 2016 at 3:28:04 PM UTC-4, Eric Innocents EBOULET wrote:
However yesterday, a new error appears. This new window opens
It is in the file attached.

We're going to need more information about what steps led to this problem. I would start by deleting any .rda or .RData files in your working directory that might be getting loaded. The RStudio guys mentioned that they have made some changes to reduce the number of crashes in the more recent preview releases:

http://www.rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download/preview

Ben
